verdict.rationale: Veriff has extensive documented webhook support: decision webhooks, event (progress) webhooks, watchlist-screening webhooks, and user-defined-status webhooks, all secured via HMAC signatures, allowing subscribers (including AI-native agents) to receive real-time events instead of polling. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of AI-agent-specific consumption patterns or independent/hands-on third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs.
